Yes by default: next/image uses the built-in loader, so the browser requests /_next/image on your Next server, which fetches the remote image, resizes it and caches it, so the first request for each avatar size hits the node process and later ones are served from the cache. The earlier build check showed avatars resolving through /_next/image. Action: if you want the CDN to serve them directly, I can check how it's deployed and set a custom loader or unoptimized for those avatars.
